findings.description: [00-zoom-activity-v2.png] [DEFECT] Severe text collisions in RECENT ACTIVITY panel (right column, rows 2–8): Left-aligned `repo · Issue/PR #NNN` labels overlap directly with `Nov 24, 2026 · 16:3x JST` timestamps — rows 2–3 (`herdr-t3 · PR #157`) collide with `Nov`, rows 4 & 7 (`tastile-root · Issue #158`) heavily overwrite `Nov 24,`, rows 5–6 (`tastile-root · PR #159`) overlap `Nov`, row 8 (`herdr-t3 · Issue #156`) overlaps `Nov`, and row 1 (`ty-plus · PR #572`) leaves almost zero horizontal gap. Compact the timestamp format (omit repeated date/year) or truncate long repo labels.

[00-zoom-activity-v2.png] [DEFECT] Outer footer collides with left inner panel border (bottom-left): `observed Nov 24, 2026 · 16:41 JST · rebuildup.dev` starts outside the left panel's left border, runs straight over the bottom border stroke, and crowds `public activity only` directly above `rebuildup.dev`. Increase SVG height or shorten the inner panels so the footer sits cleanly below them.

[00-zoom-activity-v2.png] [DEFECT] Zero left padding inside EVENTS BY REPOSITORY panel (left column): `4,364`, all six repository icons and green bars (`rebuildup/herdr-t3` through `rebuildup/tiny-chess-01`), `+24 more repositories`, and `8 private repos · 1490 commits · 548 PRs (aggregated)` sit flush against the inner panel's left border stroke, misaligned with the indented `EVENTS BY REPOSITORY` header above them.

[01-zoom-current.png] [DEFECT] Missing weight labels required by specification: The specification requires in-progress projects with weight labels, but all five rows show only identical blue dots with no weight labels, badges, or indicators, leaving the right half of the card completely blank.

[00-zoom-activity-v2.png] [DEFECT] Contradictory honest-state scope labels (left panel bottom): `public activity only` appears directly beneath `8 private repos · 1490 commits · 548 PRs (aggregated)`, contradicting whether private activity is included. Clarify which counts are public-only vs. aggregated private totals.

[00-zoom-activity-v2.png] [DEFECT] Low contrast on muted secondary text at README display size (~350–760px): Timestamps (`Nov 24, 2026 · 16:3x JST`), `12 ev`–`1 ev` labels, `+24 more repositories`, `8 private repos...`, `observed Nov 24, 2026 · 16:41 JST · rebuildup.dev`, `public activity only`, and `times in JST` use dim gray on dark surfaces that will lose legibility when scaled down.

[01-zoom-current.png] [DEFECT] Honest-state mismatch with generic boilerplate status lines: The footer states `names and status lines are the owner's declarations` alongside `declared + measured`, yet all five descriptions are identical auto-generated fallbacks (`GitHub 上で活動が観測された公開/非公開リポジトリ。`) and row 4 is a generic placeholder (`非公開プロジェクト`), conveying no project-specific meaning and contradicting the declaration disclaimer.

[01-zoom-current.png] [DEFECT] Low contrast on muted footer and overflow count: `+11 more on rebuildup.dev`, `as of 2026-11-24 · names and status lines are the owner's declarations`, and `declared + measured · rebuildup.dev` are dim against the dark background and will be hard to read at ~350px README width.

[00-zoom-activity-v2.png] [OPPORTUNITY] Differentiate repeated feed entries and tighten visual hierarchy: `herdr-t3 · PR #157`, `tastile-root · PR #159`, and `tastile-root · Issue #158` each appear twice in RECENT ACTIVITY without action verbs (opened/merged/commented) or a legend for blue square vs. purple triangle markers. Also clarify how `20 events` (sum of the 6 listed bars) relates to `+24 more repositories` and `4,364 commits`, and add a few pixels of vertical spacing between `EVENTS BY REPOSITORY` and `4,364`.

[01-zoom-current.png] [OPPORTUNITY] Improve visual balance, timestamp granularity, and language consistency: Placing the missing weight labels/bars on the right will balance the large empty right half of the card; adding time-of-day and timezone (e.g., JST) to `as of 2026-11-24` will match the activity card's honest-state precision; and aligning the Japanese fallback copy with the English UI chrome would improve consistency.

[INPUTS] Incomplete image set vs. specification: Only 2 of the 6 cards listed in the specification (`00-zoom-activity-v2.png` activity card and `01-zoom-current.png` in-progress projects card) were attached; Discord presence chip, stats, top-langs, and streak cards were not present in the input directory.

verdict.summary: Per-image verdicts: (1) 00-zoom-activity-v2.png (Activity card): REJECT — critical overlapping text across 7 of 8 rows in RECENT ACTIVITY, zero left padding inside EVENTS BY REPOSITORY causing text/icons/bars to collide with the inner border, outer observation footer colliding with the left panel's bottom border, contradictory public-only vs. aggregated private repo labels, and low-contrast muted text. (2) 01-zoom-current.png (In-progress projects card): ACCEPT WITH FIXES — clean layout with no text collisions or clipping, but missing required weight labels, repetitive auto-generated Japanese fallback descriptions that contradict the "owner's declarations" footer, and low-contrast muted footer text. Note: Only 2 of the 6 cards referenced in the specification were attached.
